tagline.zh: 从镜头目标出发，让生成、控制与后期衔接起来。
tagline.en: Connecting visual ideas, generation, control and finishing.

about.zh: 我是葛津亦（Leo），昆士兰大学信息系统硕士，有数据分析工作经历，目前聚焦 AIGC 图像与视频创作、ComfyUI 工作流搭建与调试、LoRA 训练评估，以及 AI 短剧的剧本、分镜与剪辑。我的实践包括《雨停之前》43 秒叙事开场、足球题材 AI 戏仿短剧、角色与风格 LoRA、崩铁 MMD 成片、3D 驱动 AI 动作实验及 AI 应用项目。我负责需求拆解、视觉参考、审片与迭代取舍，并与 Agent 协作调试脚本、复核输出和整理版本记录。目前关注上海的 AIGC 与创意技术岗位。
about.en: I’m Leo (葛津亦), an Information Systems master’s graduate from the University of Queensland with a background in data analysis. I focus on AI image and video creation, building and debugging ComfyUI workflows, LoRA training and review, and scripts, shot design and editing for AI shorts. My practice includes the 43-second opening of Before the Rain Stops, football-themed AI parody shorts, character and style LoRA studies, a completed HSR MMD film, 3D-driven AI motion experiments, and AI applications. I define requirements and visual references, review outputs and choose revisions, and work with agents on scripts, output checks and version records. I’m interested in AIGC and creative technology roles in Shanghai.

title.zh: 雨停之前 · 叙事开场

description.zh: 43 秒雨夜叙事开场。我负责创意、分镜、美术参考、素材筛选与审片，并与 Agent 协作组织预演和后期流程。现有版本包含电视画面合成与音频接缝处理，声音等细节仍可改进。
description.en: A 43-second narrative opening set on a rainy night. I developed the concept, shot goals and visual references, selected footage and reviewed revisions, working with agents on previs and finishing. This excerpt includes TV-screen compositing and audio-seam treatment; sound and other details remain open to refinement.

title.zh: The Weave · 程序化视觉短片

description.zh: 30 秒代码生成影像实验，以一根发光的线串联织机、计算机与神经网络等意象。画面、运动与声音由程序生成，探索技术结构如何成为视觉叙事；此处为压缩网页预览。
description.en: A 30-second code-rendered visual experiment following a luminous thread through weaving, computing and neural-network imagery. Procedural pictures, movement and synthesized sound explore technical structure as visual storytelling. This is a compressed web preview.

title.zh: 雨停之前 · 电视画面合成对照
title.en: Before the Rain Stops · Compositing Study

description.zh: 同一镜头中原片与电视画面替换后的关键帧对照。我提出修改目标，与 Agent 协作适配脚本并复查替换范围、文字及电视外壳。该处理针对近固定镜头；对照用于检查局部变化。
description.en: Matched frames before and after replacing the TV picture in the same shot. I set the revision goals and worked with agents on script adaptation and checks of the replacement area, text and TV casing. This is a near-static-shot treatment, shown to inspect local changes.

title.zh: ComfyUI · 角色与 LoRA 测试

description.zh: 现有 LoRA 测试中的近景、全身与姿态样图。围绕角色身份、服装和局部细节比较生成结果，调整提示词与模型强度，保留参数及版本记录。角色与基础模型来自第三方，配置、检查与文档含 AI 辅助。
description.en: Existing close-up, full-body and pose samples from LoRA tests. I compare character identity, clothing and local detail, adjust prompts and model strength, and keep parameter and version records. The character and base model are third-party; configuration, checks and documentation were AI-assisted.

title.zh: 3D 舞蹈创作 · 崩铁 MMD

description.zh: 《The Bass》崩铁记忆队 MMD 已完成：15.33 秒，720 × 1280、30fps。采用 PMX / VMD 与 Blender 制作，涵盖四角色镜头、表情、光影和局部接触修订；另有 13 秒 3D 驱动 AI 动作实验。封面左、中为 MMD 选帧，右为 AI 实验选帧。打开详情可播放 MMD 成片。角色、动作及相关素材为第三方，工程与脚本含 Agent 协作。
description.en: The Bass HSR Memory Team MMD is complete: 15.33 seconds, 720 × 1280 at 30 fps. Made with PMX / VMD and Blender, with revisions to four-character camera cuts, expressions, lighting and local contact. The separate 13-second 3D-driven AI motion study is also retained. Left and centre cover frames are from MMD; the right frame is from the AI study. Open the project page to play the completed MMD film. Characters, motion and related assets are third-party; scene and script work was agent-assisted.

title.zh: AI 短剧创作 · 剧本、分镜与剪辑
title.en: AI Shorts · Scripts, Shot Design & Editing

description.zh: 足球题材 AI 戏仿创作，覆盖创意、剧本、镜头设计、角色表演、素材审片与剪辑。封面为片段选帧；打开详情可播放《Who Is Yamal?》26 秒完整短片、《Other Areas》64 秒完整短剧及采访镜头模型对照。制作过程含 Agent 协作。
description.en: Football-themed AI parody shorts covering ideas, scripts, shot design, character performance, footage review and editing. The cover shows selected frames. Open the project page to play the complete shorts Who Is Yamal? (26 seconds) and Other Areas (64 seconds), alongside the interview-shot model tests. Production was agent-assisted.
